intro.text: A member of the Ghostbloods who trained Mraize and keeps watch on Shallan for the group.
A masked, high-ranking Ghostblood and Mraize's teacher, who has bonded an inkspren and can use the powers of an Elsecaller.

items.text: Iyatil was already living on Roshar by 1173, where she had trained Mraize. After Shallan's first meeting with the Ghostbloods, Iyatil tried to track her, then set out to watch her in secret. Pattern spotted her, and Shallan used a Lightweaving to trick her into showing herself. Iyatil recovered quickly, explained that Shallan was to look into a madman newly arrived in the warcamps, and helped her get into the monastery where he was kept.

After the Battle of Narak, Iyatil tried to kill Highprince Meridas Amaram with poisoned darts from a blowgun. Taln stopped her before she could finish the job, and when Amaram summoned his Shardblade she escaped with ease.

During the True Desolation, Iyatil kept working behind the scenes. Her master, Thaidakar, wanted control of the Oathgates so that Stormlight could be gathered and moved. Iyatil told him this was impossible, which displeased him, so she and Mraize settled for trying to gain access to the gates instead, and Mraize tried to bring Raboniel to the table by giving her a valuable Threnodite chain.

Before the contest of champions, Iyatil brought two more Ghostbloods, Aleen and Lieke, to Roshar from off-world. With Mraize she told the cell of their plan to enter the Spiritual Realm and find the prison of Ba-Ado-Mishram. She, Mraize and Lieke slipped into the Windrunner guard and attacked Shallan, Renarin and Rlain, wounding Shallan with a blowgun before they were pulled into the collapsing perpendicularity.

In the Spiritual Realm, Iyatil disguised herself as Formless and appeared to Shallan in several visions, urging her to kill Mraize and Dalinar. Shallan saw through the disguise and struck her with an anti-Stormlight knife. When Iyatil tried to heal herself with Stormlight, the reaction exploded and killed her.

appearance.text: She always wears a red-orange carapace mask made of pieces like a mosaic. It covers the area around her eyes, looks angry and seems to be growing into her skin. She never takes it off, and will kill anyone who tries to remove it.

Iyatil is small and wears a plain dark brown shirt and trousers with an intricate belt that seems studded with carapace, gloves and a dagger at her side, adding a black cloak when she trails someone. She leaves her safehand bare, and Shallan at first took her for a man. She has tan skin and is middle-aged.

personality.text: Iyatil is stealthy and observant, seeming to appear out of nowhere. She keeps herself informed about the security, schedules and layout of wherever she is, tracks and hides well, and is trained with several weapons, which makes her an effective spy and assassin.

Her dark, beady eyes rarely blink and her face gives nothing away, which many find unsettling. She says no more than she must, often refusing to answer at all, and uses others' weaknesses to her advantage. She collects items from across the cosmere and keeps them in a trophy case.

Iyatil calls Mraize her student and closely supervised his training. She thinks he is too focused on himself and loses sight of the organization's larger purpose. She advises him and even forbade him to travel to other worlds; he respects her ability but resents her restrictions.
